Admin routes of the product specs module. Every route needs a staff session and the permission named on it; send `X-Resolve-Locale: false` to receive every locale of a translatable field for editing.

## GET /v1/admin/product-specs/labels

List distinct product specification labels

Parameters:

- `page` in query (number, min 1, optional).
- `pageSize` in query (number, min 1, max 50, optional).
- `search` in query (string, max length 120, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: Labels returned.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.
